cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: SLES at position 2 makes this ordinary effective cleansing, while CAPB, coco-glucoside and refatting/protein care keep it from strong.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: The sensitive/mild claim cannot by itself lower an SLES-led formula to low.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: several light-to-meaningful routes, including glyceryl oleate, protein, panthenol and cationic guar, should give bounded softness without a silicone-rich or 2-in-1 system.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: No silicones and no clearly rich 2-in-1 architecture are present.

weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: interacting light deposition routes make bounded residue plausible, while no silicone stack and SLES-led cleansing keep it below high.
weightPotential.counterSignal: Silicone-free positioning, rinse-off use and SLES/CAPB cleansing argue against a high weight band.

unresolvedFacts: Exact levels of cationic guar, protein and refatting esters are not knowable from INCI order alone.
weightAssessment.whyThisBand: The formula has more than a single light polymer or late oil: refatter, fatty ester, protein and cationic guar interact.
weightAssessment.whyNotNeighborBand: Not low because the routes are multiple and not all late; not high because there is no silicone stack or rich oil/butter system and cleansing reset is meaningful.

focusPrimary.counterSignal: SLES at position 2 is a cleansing-strength counter-signal but does not erase the explicit gentle/sensitive positioning.
